mostWorthwhile.text: Putting debris into bound orbit was most worthwhile: it connected the impact to Moon-forming material while acknowledging alternative models.

leastWorthwhile.text: Setting Theia on its collision course felt least engaging because it was the only offered action, though the explanation of impact geometry was useful.

surprise.text: I appreciated that the debris-disk route is one family of models and that some simulations form a large satellite more directly.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, although the first two choices were the only combinations offered, so there was little decision-making in them.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see how the orbiting debris becomes the Moon, especially given the uncertainty mentioned here.
